name: SOC Codes
description: Official BLS classification structure defining every 6-digit occupation code and title; the master taxonomy every other source keys off.

name: BLS OEWS
description: Government wage and employment survey giving actual headcount and pay by SOC code nationally; the 'ground truth' size/wage anchor for each occupation today.

name: BLS Employment Projections
description: 10-year government forecast of employment growth/decline and job openings by SOC code; separates AI-driven change from pre-existing structural trends.

name: O*NET Occupation Data
description: O*NET's master list of occupation codes, titles, and descriptions; the plain-English definition of the job and the SOC <-> O*NET-SOC crosswalk.

name: O*NET Task Statements
description: Task-level breakdown of each occupation; the foundation every AI-exposure study scores against.

name: Anthropic Economic Index - Job Exposure
description: Real-world, usage-based AI exposure score per occupation from actual Claude conversations; how much AI is ACTUALLY being used for this job right now.

name: Anthropic Economic Index - Task Penetration
description: Same usage-based data at individual-task grain; shows which specific tasks within a role are AI-penetrated vs. untouched.

name: OECD AI Exposure (Capability Gap Index)
description: Forward-looking index comparing AI's current capabilities against occupational demands across nine skill domains; a 5-10 year outlook rather than current usage.
